feature_name: BullMQ Background Job Provider with Dashboard
description: Implement a new Redis-backed background job provider using BullMQ as an alternative to the existing Inngest and Local providers. This should include a Bull Board dashboard for job monitoring accessible via a dedicated API route. The system should integrate with the existing BackgroundJob table for audit tracking and work across both Vite and Hono bundles.
functional_requirements: Create a BullMQ job provider with Redis connection support, configurable concurrency settings, exponential backoff retries, and cron scheduling capabilities
Build a Bull Board dashboard UI accessible at /api/jobs/board with admin-only access in production environments and open access in development
Integrate the new provider with the existing BackgroundJob table system to maintain audit trails and job history tracking
Implement a singleton pattern to share the BullMQ instance across both Vite and Hono application bundles
Add Redis service support to the development Docker Compose setup and configure Vite to properly handle Bull Board static assets
